$comment: Derived from FluffyTaill/astra-companion-life@v1.5.0. Digests are of the bytes the bot downloaded and the attestation covers. Ownership proved by: unrecorded.

fire_trigger.reason: Plays her pastimes and says her rare words through the Astra commands the plugin page creates.

send_chat_message.reason: Optional: asks Astra for a short line in her voice now and then (off unless turned on).

set_variable.reason: Publishes her mood, hunger, health, friendship level and coins as Astra variables (companion_*) for your commands and other plugins.
